exercises.solution:
def iou(a, b):
    ix1, iy1 = max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])
    ix2, iy2 = min(a[2], b[2]), min(a[3], b[3])
    inter = max(0, ix2 - ix1) * max(0, iy2 - iy1)
    area = lambda r: (r[2] - r[0]) * (r[3] - r[1])
    union = area(a) + area(b) - inter
    return round(inter / union, 4) if union else 0.0

dsaProblems.title: Urutan Kuliah Terkecil
dsaProblems.story: n mata kuliah (0..n-1), prereq (a, b) berarti a sebelum b. Kembalikan urutan topologis terkecil secara leksikografis, atau [] jika ada siklus.
dsaProblems.rustSignature: fn course_order(n: usize, prereqs: &[(usize, usize)]) -> Vec<usize>
dsaProblems.solution:
def course_order(n, prereqs):
    import heapq
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    indeg = [0] * n
    for a, b in prereqs:
        adj[a].append(b)
        indeg[b] += 1
    h = [i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0]
    heapq.heapify(h)
    out = []
    while h:
        u = heapq.heappop(h)
        out.append(u)
        for v in adj[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(h, v)
    return out if len(out) == n else []
dsaProblems.complexity: waktu O((V+E) log V), ruang O(V+E)

dsaProblems.title: Subarray Berjumlah K
dsaProblems.story: Hitung banyaknya subarray kontigu yang berjumlah tepat k (nilai bisa negatif).
dsaProblems.solution:
def count_subarrays_sum_k(nums, k):
    from collections import defaultdict
    seen = defaultdict(int)
    seen[0] = 1
    s = cnt = 0
    for x in nums:
        s += x
        cnt += seen[s - k]
        seen[s] += 1
    return cnt
hints: Hitung berapa kali P[j]-k pernah muncul.
Simpan frekuensi prefix di dict (mulai dengan {0:1}).
